_primary_source_opened_cell_comments.text: Provenance corrected 2026-09-11. This offload previously cited full ticket 1124426237444, which is labelled GPRX5236 LD2 and dated 8-25-26 -- a different railcar, from the August week -- paired with an unlabelled 9-03 empty (1312226246373). Both pairs give an identical 43,760 lb delta, so the MASS was always right; only the evidence was wrong. Now cites the correctly labelled GPRX5254 LD2 pair: FULL 1124426245497 (73,380 lb) / EMPTY 1312226245354 (29,620 lb), both 9-02. Reminder: a +0.00 reconciliation proves the mass, never the ticket.

Recovered 2026-09-11. Both tickets ARE labelled GPRX5107 but carry no LD number (a documented label variant), which is why an earlier label search reported no pair. LD assigned by trailer + chronology: CH2 ran LD2 and LD3, CH1 ran LD1 and LD4. FULL 1124426244484 (72,600 lb, 9-01 10:51, CH2); EMPTY 1312226244341 (28,480 lb, 9-01 15:35, CH2). Net 20,012.48 kg vs COBB 19,995.58 (+16.90) -- scale ticket is authoritative over COBB per rig-QC rule. Corroboration: with LD3 included the four offloads sum to 78,026.90 kg against a BOL of 78,010, a 16.90 kg overage now trued up by the col-J uncertainty adjustment.

cell_comments.text: Corrected 2026-09-11 from 27.01 to 20.17 MT per Garrett. The BOL scan states Qty shipped 27.01 M.Tons and is internally consistent with tanker full 42,870 - tare 15,860 = 27,010 kg and with 22,523 L x 1.1992 density. BUT the same BOL also reports Volume loaded with level change = 17,024 L / 4,498 Usgal, and 17,024 x 1.1992 = 20,415 kg - i.e. the BOL contradicts itself across two volume bases, 6,840 kg apart. Loads tab col Q (the canonical BOL-mass-at-60F source) reads 20.17 MT and its col R gallons (4,498) matches the BOL level-change volume exactly. 27.01 t would also be a 33 percent outlier against the other 13 loads this week (19.22-20.04 t). Adopted the Loads value. Raise with AECN/Samah if the BOL is meant to be authoritative.

COBB quantity_consumed_in_injection / offloaded_quantity_kg for 2495-T reads 19,510 kg, but the AECN Analytical Details BOL (2495-T, RS2-280829-1) shows 'Quantity send in M.Tons at 60F' = 19.99 MT = 19,990 kg -- a 480 kg / 2.4% discrepancy. Per COBB-validation policy the BOL is authoritative; 19,990 kg is used here. Flag to Garrett / upstream COBB owner for correction.

deterministic_script.reason: Schema v1.0 models a single-offload rail batch (scale_tickets.full_ticket / offload / railcar top-level keys). rail_uncertainty_precondition.note: Both railcars fully drawn down this week (Ops Notes P10/P11 = FULL; offload sums 77,654.95 and 78,026.90 kg vs 77,870 and 78,010 kg loaded). Per-offload framing books 8 x 72.57 = 580.56 kg on the rail mass, more than the 6 inbound weighings (435.42 kg) would.
